# 2025 Robert Morris Colonials football team

The 2025 Robert Morris Colonials football team will represent Robert Morris University as a member of the Northeast Conference (NEC) during the 2025 NCAA Division I FCS football season. The Colonials, who will be led by eighth-year head coach Bernard Clark, play home games at the Joe Walton Stadium in Moon Township, Pennsylvania.
